algorithm.definition: A step-by-step procedure for solving a problem

complexity.definition: A measure of the resources required by an algorithm

variable.definition: A storage location paired with an associated symbolic name

argument.definition: A value passed to a function when it is called

compile.definition: To translate source code into executable code

runtime.definition: The period when a program is executing

derivative.definition: The rate of change of a function
